M11 — 2026-10-05
From rc.5 on, sofar.sh's postinstall (install.mjs) puts the native Rust core on PATH. Current npm blocks install scripts unless they are allowed, which leaves the JS shim in place (correct output, but not native). Install with `npm install -g --prefix ~/.local --allow-scripts=sofar.sh sofar.sh@<ver>` and check that `file $(readlink -f ~/.local/bin/sofar-core)` reports a Mach-O binary. The bench's pinned ~/.bench installs need the same flag, or round 4 measures the shim, not the core.
